title: Non-radial solutions for the quasi-linear Hénon type $N$-Laplacian Liouville equation
summary: In this paper, we investigate the following quasi-linear weighted $N$-Laplacian Liouville equation \begin{equation*}\label{0} -Δ_N u=|x|^{Nα}e^{u}, \qquad x\in \R^N, \end{equation*} where $N \geq 2$. For $\al>0$, by carefully studying the linearized problem and applying the approximation method and bifurcation theory, we prove that, when the parameter $α$ equals to the critical values $α(k):=\frac{\sqrt{k(N-1)(k+N-2)}}{N-1}-1$ for $k \geq 2$, there exist non-radial solutions $u$ (bifurcating from $U_{α(k)}$) to the above quasi-linear Hénon type Liouville equation such that $u\sim \ln|x|$,…
